t: 亨利二世是皇帝奥托三世的堂兄弟,当选并加冕为德国国王.
te: Henry II, a cousin of Emperor Otto III, is elected and crowned King of Germany.
dz: 亨利二世是皇帝奥托三世的堂兄弟,当选并加冕为德国国王.
de: Henry II, a cousin of Emperor Otto III, is elected and crowned King of Germany.

t: 教宗约翰八世承认布兰尼米尔公爵领导下的克罗地亚公国为独立国家.
te: Pope John VIII recognises the Duchy of Croatia under Duke Branimir as an independent state.
dz: 教宗约翰八世承认布兰尼米尔公爵领导下的克罗地亚公国为独立国家.
de: Pope John VIII recognises the Duchy of Croatia under Duke Branimir as an independent state.

t: 特奥多修斯二世皇帝在君士坦丁堡(拜占庭帝国)与艾莉娅·尤多西亚结婚.
te: Emperor Theodosius II marries Aelia Eudocia at Constantinople (Byzantine Empire).
dz: 特奥多修斯二世皇帝在君士坦丁堡(拜占庭帝国)与艾莉娅·尤多西亚结婚.
de: Emperor Theodosius II marries Aelia Eudocia at Constantinople (Byzantine Empire).
